shared_elements: carved stone surface with incised/low-relief motifs
repeated small shapes arranged in bands or rows
justification: Both are weathered stone surfaces bearing shallow carved motifs including circles/discs and curved arcs, and both use loosely horizontal banding of small forms. However, A is a flat wall covered edge-to-edge with dense, tiny, orderly rows of repeated signs, whereas B is a three-dimensional figural sculpture whose few large, sparse, bilaterally symmetrical motifs follow the contours of a body, giving an entirely different scale, density and manner of execution.
